notes: internal/config is written whole by w0-config from the design.md configuration table, so later nodes do not edit it. A node that needs a new setting is a lane widening, not a silent edit.
Migrations are goose files in internal/db/migrations, numbered from the 'schema' sequence at dispatch. Workers never pick a number.
VERSION is bumped by every source PR (git-workflow rule): every merge invalidates every open branch's VERSION line. Expect a one-line rebase per merge; do not sequence around it.
internal/web is a server/router package plus one subpackage per feature area (internal/web/<area>/**), shared templ layout in internal/web/layout: ADR-00012.
E2E runs @playwright/test from e2e/, test-only and never shipped: ADR-00013.
Greenfield: every glob names a path that does not exist yet. Waves follow docs/design.md (W0-W7, W8 = households per ADR-00018, Later = wave 9).

Generated sqlc packages (storedb, catalogdb, shoppingdb, householddb) are never hand-edited; make generate rewrites them. Two nodes that write one package may share a round: they merge in sequence, and the later one rebases and runs make generate. Two nodes that each add a migration never share a round, because every migration regenerates every package's models.go and draws from the one schema sequence.
Wave 9 nodes are deferred and recorded blocked until their own ADR: meal planning by ADR-00011.

shared_files.note: APPEND-ONLY by convention: add new files, or new lines to existing files, never edit existing lines; the dispatcher enforces this in diff review. mode is open only because overseer graph-core partition_by_lane exempts open shared entries alone and counts append_only as outside every lane, which would fail record-done; switch back to append_only when the plugin honours it.

APPEND-ONLY by convention: add new files, or new lines to existing files, never edit existing lines; the dispatcher enforces this in diff review. mode is open only because overseer graph-core partition_by_lane exempts open shared entries alone and counts append_only as outside every lane, which would fail record-done; switch back to append_only when the plugin honours it.

APPEND-ONLY by convention: add new lines only, never edit existing ones; the dispatcher enforces this in diff review. mode is open only because overseer graph-core partition_by_lane exempts open shared entries alone and counts append_only as outside every lane, which would fail record-done; switch back to append_only when the plugin honours it.

APPEND-ONLY by convention: a node that introduces a domain sentinel adds its import and one row to statusTable, never edits existing lines; the dispatcher enforces this in diff review. statusTable is first-match, so a sentinel that wraps one already listed must go above it -- the one case where a new row is inserted rather than appended, called out in that node's PR. It is the one place a domain error becomes an HTTP status (error-handling rule). mode is open for the same partition_by_lane reason as the other append-only entries.

APPEND-ONLY by convention (ADR-00014 keeps queries per package; within one package several nodes add queries): a node adds its own new .sql file, or a new entry, and never edits another node's; the dispatcher enforces this in diff review. mode is open for the same partition_by_lane reason as the other append-only entries.

APPEND-ONLY by convention (ADR-00014 keeps queries per package; within one package several nodes add queries): a node adds its own new .sql file, or a new entry, and never edits another node's; the dispatcher enforces this in diff review. mode is open for the same partition_by_lane reason as the other append-only entries.

APPEND-ONLY by convention: a node adds its own package entry (e.g. w4-shopping-store's internal/shopping) and never edits another package's entry; the dispatcher enforces this in diff review. mode is open for the same partition_by_lane reason as the other append-only entries.
